newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks shed gains, NYSE lifts trading curbs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks shed gains, NYSE lifts trading curbs.

text.p: Wall Street stocks backed off session highs, holding to slender gains in afternoon trading on Tuesday.
The Dow industrials were up 25 points at 8146, prompting the New York Stock Exchange to lift curbs on index-arbitrage trading at 1442 EDT/1842 GMT.

The general tone of the market remained positive. Market breadth favored advancers by a roughly five to four margin on the NYSE. Financial stocks paced the gains, boosted by a firm bond market, where the 30-year U.S. Treasury rose 11/32 to yield 6.38 percent.
